content: The elevation of Los Angeles (LA) varies because the city covers a large area with diverse terrain, but the average elevation of downtown Los Angeles is approximately 285 feet (87 meters) above sea level. Elevations in LA range from sea level at the coast to over 1,500 feet (460 meters) in the hills and surrounding areas.
